payload.posture: Read Matthew 20:17–19 as one movement in the resurrection, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states on the way to Jerusalem, Jesus names condemnation, delivery, mockery, scourging, crucifixion, and raising. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the resurrection.
